title: QUIC RFC 9000 Maximum ACK Delay Alarm Slack Policy Verification
verification_method: Focused S18P2-0015 requirement-home tests over max_ack_delay alarm-slack policy composition and runtime ACK-delay scheduling, plus Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, full Release test suite, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers the runtime's local max_ack_delay default explicitly including expected alarm-firing delay and the ACK-delay timer using the composed default or explicit local value.
expected_result: The focused tests show the default max_ack_delay policy includes non-zero alarm slack, absent local transport parameters schedule ACK delay at that composed default, explicit composed values schedule ACK delay at the exact composed value, and large component sums saturate instead of wrapping.
procedure: Run the focused S18P2-0015 and S13P2P1 ACK-delay requirement-home filter.
Run the full Release test suite without rebuilding.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The runtime ACK-delay path uses elapsed microsecond budgets.
The local max_ack_delay value is either present in local transport parameters or falls back to the runtime policy default.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim public max_ack_delay configuration APIs, transport-parameter wire serialization changes, broader Section 18.2 closure outside REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S18P2-0015, ACK delay exponent or PTO changes, or hosted interop readiness.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-06. The Release build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, the focused S18P2-0015 plus S13P2P1 ACK-delay regression filter passed 12/12, regenerated coverage triage marks REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S18P2-0015 trace_clean and reports 1,261 of 1,771 QUIC requirements trace-clean overall, core SpecTrace JSON validation passed for 445 artifacts, the full Release no-build suite passed 4,464/4,464, and git diff --check returned exit code 0 with line-ending warnings only.
